Overview.Title: UK and Poland:  Security and Defence Partnership

Items.Value: That the Grand Committee takes note of the Treaty between the UK and Poland on a Security and Defence Partnership. Relevant document: 3rd Report of the International Agreements Committee

My Lords, I am particularly delighted that we are having this debate on the day that President Zelensky is in London meeting the Prime Minister, I think while we are having this discussion. That only highlights the importance of agreements such as this.
